findings.area: be/src/names.ts canonical name key (teacher uniqueness + reserved demo name)
findings.title: The lookalike table only covers the LOWERCASE forms, so capital Cyrillic/Greek homoglyphs (and a combining mark after a space or digit) still produce a twin of a colleague's name or of the reserved demo teacher name
findings.evidence: Live on :4701 (NODE_ENV=test, DEMO_MODE=1): after registering 'Marie Dubois', 'Mаrie Dubois' with Cyrillic U+041C is accepted (201); same for U+041A K, U+0422 T, U+041D H, Greek U+0397 Eta, U+0392 Beta, U+039D Nu, U+0396 Zeta (8 of 18 probes). The reserved demo name is bypassed too: 'Dr. Claire \u041Coreau' and 'Dr. Claire \u039Coreau' both register as teachers (201) while 'dr claire moreau' and 'DR. CLAIRE MOREAU!' are refused. Cause: names.ts fold() lower-cases before LOOKALIKE_RE runs, so only the glyphs that look Latin in lower case (а с е о р х у і ј ѕ ... α ο ν ρ ι υ κ χ) are mapped; capitals whose lowercase does not look Latin (М К Т Н В, Η Β Ζ Μ Τ Ε Υ Ν) are not. In the same function ACCENT only strips a mark that directly follows a Latin/Greek/Cyrillic letter, so 'Zoe \u0301Quinn', 'Zoe Quinn \u0301' and 'Zoe Quinn1\u0301' (mark after space or digit) get a different key and register (201). Round 10 note says only 'other scripts and digit/letter swaps' are residual; this is worse than documented because it is the same two scripts and the most natural capital-letter attack on names.
findings.repro: cd scratchpad/r11-A; node homo.mjs; node homo2.mjs; node mark.mjs (against a server started per the setup, port 4701, TEACHER_INVITE_CODE=inv-r11, RATE_REGISTER_PER_HOUR large). Offline: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning key1.ts prints SAME/diff per pair ('М'/'M' diff).
findings.expected: Two teacher display names that read the same to a person (including capital homoglyphs and the reserved 'Dr. Claire Moreau') cannot coexist: 409 name_taken.
findings.actual: 201 for 8 of the 18 homoglyph probes, for the demo-name lookalike with Cyrillic/Greek capital M, and for names with a combining mark after whitespace/digit.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/names.ts:19-24 (fold/skeleton): map the confusables on the original-case string (or add capital entries: Cyrillic В Н К М Т, Greek Β Ζ Η Μ Ν Τ Ε Υ) BEFORE toLowerCase, or use the UTS #39 confusables skeleton table; also drop any \p{M} that does not follow a letter (ACCENT should fall back to stripping all Mn/Me marks in the key). Update KNOWN_LIMITATIONS 'Round 10 notes' accordingly.

findings.area: be/src/http.ts hasVisibleCharacter vs be/src/names.ts HIDDEN (register, rename)
findings.title: Names made only of private-use or unassigned default-ignorable code points pass validation, fold to the empty key and are stored as a blank name; every later such teacher name gets a misleading 409 name_taken
findings.evidence: POST /api/auth/register with name U+E000 (teacher AND student) -> 201 with user.name '\ue000' (renders blank/tofu). A second teacher named U+E001, U+2065, U+FFF0 or two PUA chars -> 409 name_taken 'Another teacher account already uses this name.' (all share the sentinel key '\0' because HIDDEN in names.ts:11 strips \p{Co} and Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, while the validator's INVISIBLE class in http.ts:41 does not contain them). PUT /api/profile rename of an existing teacher to U+E002 -> 409 for the same reason. Students get a blank-looking stored name (201). The round-10 brief required names that fold to empty to be rejected cleanly, not stored.
findings.expected: 400 validation_error (name has no visible character) for every name that would fold to an empty key; no blank name stored; no bogus name_taken.
findings.actual: First one stored, the rest answer 409 name_taken.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/http.ts:41 add \p{Co} and \p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point} to INVISIBLE; and/or be/src/game.ts Game.checkDisplayName: throw bad() when nameKey(name) === '\u0000' (names.ts:40).

findings.title: A client that disconnects mid-body is logged as an internal error with a stack trace ('Error: aborted', ECONNRESET) and the server tries to answer 500 on the dead socket
findings.evidence: Raw socket sends 'POST /api/auth/login' with Content-Length: 100 and 8 bytes of body, then closes: the server log gets 'Error: aborted at abortIncoming ... code: ECONNRESET' (console.error(e) in the non-ApiError branch). Anyone can fill the log with stacks at will; real faults drown in noise.
findings.repro:
scratchpad/r11-A: start server, node -e "net.connect(PORT,'127.0.0.1',c=>{c.write('POST /api/auth/login HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 100

{"email"');setTimeout(()=>c.destroy(),200)})" ; see s4771.log / s4701.log
findings.expected: Aborted uploads are dropped silently (or one-line debug), not reported as unhandled errors.
findings.actual: Full stack on stderr per aborted request.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/app.ts catch: if ((e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ECONNRESET' || req.destroyed) return; before console.error(e).

findings.title: Dotted-numeric values that are not IPs (HOST=999.1.1.1, 10.0.0.1.5) pass the host-name regex and fail later with a misleading 'host name cannot be resolved (ENOTFOUND)' after the database was opened; a fully-qualified name with a trailing dot ('localhost.') is rejected as invalid
findings.evidence: hostport.mjs: HOST=999.1.1.1 -> rc=1 'Cannot listen on 999.1.1.1:4727: the host name cannot be resolved (ENOTFOUND)'; HOST=10.0.0.1.5 same; HOST=x_y accepted by the regex then ENOTFOUND. All other HOST/PORT cases behave as designed (empty/space -> default, localhost -> 127.0.0.1, ::1 and [::1] ok, bad host/[::1/[]/a..b/-x/host:80 -> 'cannot start: HOST ... is not a valid IP address or host name' rc=1, PORT abc/70000/-1/3000.5/1e3/0x10/+80/65536/123456 -> rc=1 clear message, PORT=0 prints the real port, occupied port with explicit HOST -> EADDRINUSE rc=1). No secrets in any output.
findings.expected: A string that is all digits and dots but not a valid IPv4 is rejected up front with the 'not a valid IP address' message.
findings.fix_hint: app.ts:62-79: reject /^[0-9.]+$/ values that isIP() refuses; optionally accept one trailing dot.

findings.title: The claim 'restoring the demo name cannot create a duplicate' is false when a pre-round-10 twin holds the key: the demo teacher cannot rename itself back (409) yet POST /demo/reset restores the name unconditionally
findings.evidence: twins.mjs on a DB that already contains a real teacher 'DR CLAIRE MOREAU': demo teacher renamed to 'Somebody Else', PUT name 'Dr. Claire Moreau' -> 409 name_taken, POST /demo/reset -> 200 and both accounts now carry the key (users 1 'Dr. Claire Moreau' and 82 'DR CLAIRE MOREAU'). Login and rename of the twins otherwise work (A renames to a new name 200, B to A's new key 409 as designed, keeping your own key in another spelling 200).
findings.repro: cd scratchpad/r11-A; node twins.mjs $PWD (needs a.db server on 4701)
findings.expected: Documented/legacy edge: acceptable, but the code comment should not claim impossibility.
findings.actual: Reset can recreate a twin on upgraded databases.
findings.fix_hint: demo.ts reset UPDATE: skip the name restore (or log) when another teacher already holds nameKey(DEMO_TEACHER_NAME); fix the comment.

findings.title: db:backup prints a raw Node stack trace for an output path whose parent is a file (EEXIST) or a dangling symlink (SQLite 'unable to open database file')
findings.evidence: bk/notdir is a file: 'db-backup.ts bk/notdir/x.db' -> uncaught EEXIST mkdirSync stack, exit 1. bk/dangling.db -> /nonexistent/x.db: 'Error: unable to open database: ...' stack, exit 1. Permissions all HOLD: new dirs 0700, file 0600 under umask 022, existing 0755 dir kept but file 0600, spaces/quotes/semicolon in path ok, relative path ok, existing file refused (exit 2), symlink to a missing target is followed (target 0600), live db/-wal/-shm stay 0600 after the backup, backup db-check clean at schema 7.
findings.fix_hint: wrap mkdirSync/VACUUM INTO in try/catch and print e.message; note existsSync(out) follows symlinks (dangling link passes the overwrite guard).

findings.title: Cyrillic 'й' is treated as an accent on 'и' (and 'ё' on 'е'), so two different names collide ('Андрей' == 'Андреи'); Arabic harakat, Hebrew niqqud and tatweel are not folded at all ('محمد' vs 'مُحَمَّد' both register)
findings.evidence: key1.ts: nameKey('Андрей') === nameKey('Андреи'); nameKey('й') === nameKey('и'); nameKey('محمد') !== nameKey('مُحَمَّد'), nameKey('דוד') !== nameKey('דָּוִד'). Also by design: 'Anne-Marie'=='Annemarie', 'Jo Han'=='Johan', 'Müller'=='Muller' (punctuation/space/diacritic fold) return 409 'Another teacher account already uses this name.' with no hint which name.
findings.expected: Letters that are not accents stay distinct; same-script presentational marks fold.
findings.fix_hint: names.ts: exclude U+0306 on и (й) from the Cyrillic accent strip, add Arabic/Hebrew mark strip for the key only.

findings.title: The 400-character cap, trim and answer guard live only in AnthropicHintProvider; Game stores and returns whatever any other HintProvider returns
findings.evidence: hint2.ts: a provider returning '  Smaller than neighbours.  ' is stored untrimmed in hint_log.text and returned/listed verbatim; hint1.ts: a provider returning 5000 chars is not capped by Game (only the Anthropic provider caps at 400). Blank/whitespace/null/throw/500/bad JSON/non-ok all correctly fall back to the standard hint with source 'standard', penalty -15 once, hintsGiven and hint_log.text identical; refund on expiry mid-generation leaves hints_total=0, step_results.hints=0, no hint_log row, 409 time_expired. leaksAnswer still ignores answer labels of <=3 characters and point/order/match steps (documented as last line of defence).
findings.repro: cd scratchpad/r11-A; node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning hint1.ts .; node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning hint2.ts
findings.expected: Game normalises provider output (trim, max length, leaksAnswer) regardless of provider.
findings.fix_hint: game.ts after line 484: text = text?.trim() ; if (!text || text.length > 400 || leaksAnswer(text, step)) text = null.

findings.title: OpenAPI does not describe the new name rules: 409 name_taken (register and PUT /profile), the reserved '(teacher #n)' pattern, and that the 400 for that pattern carries no details array unlike other validation_error bodies
findings.evidence: openapi.json: /api/auth/register and PUT /api/profile 409 -> generic Error ref; name schema is only {minLength 1, maxLength 80, pattern \S}. Server answers 400 {error:{code:'validation_error',message:'The name cannot contain a "(teacher #number)" pattern...'}} without details. web/src/lib/api.ts tolerates both shapes (details optional) and the web client has no register UI, so no user-visible break today. Generated spec equals be/openapi.json (no drift).
findings.expected: Documented error codes and name rules.
findings.fix_hint: routes.ts S.register/S.profile name description + register summary; optional details: ['body.name ...'] in Game.checkDisplayName.
